coaching.headline: Feng Mao fed to 14 kills and one death, twelve on Countess, Legion and Argus, and only Argus ever killed Feng Mao.

flags.text: A shit trade: the last Fangtooth cost four allied deaths, and the Core fell within the next minute.
Feng Mao's 30973 objective damage beat all five allied heroes combined, 4079; the enemy took 11 structures.
Countess died eight times, double the hero norm, six on the offlane and four in enemy territory.
Kallari died nine times against a 4.32 norm; solo deaths preceded enemy Fangtooth and Orb Prime.

focus.title: Defend the base, starve Feng Mao
focus.action: After the enemy takes allied inhibitors, all five defend the base before any Fangtooth; before then, Countess and Kallari stay on the allied half whenever Feng Mao is unseen.

30.1.call: Separate plays on the offlane and mid, lost 1-4, then Orb Prime went to the allied side. Feng Mao killed Countess at the Prime pit right after the take; leave the pit together.

17.call: Lost 1-3 across three lanes with Steel already dead; Feng Mao killed Legion on the duo lane and Countess on the offlane. After a support death, the duo concedes the outer tower, not another body.

44.8.call: Fangtooth went to the allied side, but Countess died on the enemy offlane and Kallari at the pit around the take, and Feng Mao then killed Legion and Argus in the allied base. After an inhibitor falls, defend first.

83e06458-aefa-4600-a83e-d548d64771e0: Twelve wards against a norm of nine, but the jungle gold race went to Feng Mao, 24361 to 17133.
Deaths outside detected fights in the enemy half went to Crunch and Feng Mao. Cross into enemy territory only after a ward or teammate shows Feng Mao.
c8e97b9a-e2f0-4867-8715-6977799aac0e: Ten deaths, the game's most, against a norm of seven, with three on the duo lane before minute ten.
Out-earned Revenant 21650 gold to 17854 at 9.8 CS per minute against a norm of 8.1; the gold was there, the survival was not.
Rotation deaths on mid and the offlane brought no allied prize. Before leaving the duo lane, wait until a ward or ally call places Feng Mao.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: A solo death to Murdock on the enemy offlane preceded two allied inhibitors falling within the minute.
Strong farm at 10.9 CS per minute against a norm of 7.2, plus credit for the enemy offlane inner tower.
When Feng Mao is unseen, play the offlane from the allied half and step forward only after Feng Mao shows on another lane.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Team-high eight kills, three on Murdock off duo-lane rotations, plus the enemy mid outer, the first structure the allied side took.
With the enemy mid outer down early, the offlane was the open rotation. When Feng Mao shows near Countess, path to the offlane before the next death.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Damn solid anchor: the game's most damage mitigated at 79291, the game's most assists at 12, and a hand in 64 percent of team kills.
Thirteen wards against a norm of 6.4, two cleared, yet Murdock placed 33. Most Countess deaths came on the offlane: spend spare wards on the offlane river next game.

matchup: Feng Mao was the jungle opponent: 14/1/7, the game's most hero damage, and two of the nine Kallari deaths.
Feng Mao's Safeguard creates a Spellshield; blocking an ability doubles the passive stat gain.
Earth Shatter executes a hero below a health threshold and grants a free recast on the execute.
build: Malady, Vanquisher and Spear Of Desolation are the full winning core; Painweaver is the off-meta fifth item.
No item carries physical armor into a four-physical enemy comp, the flag the matchup check raised.
Vanquisher executes a hero taken below 5% health.
eternal: Vesh repeats 7% of ability damage on heroes as damage over time; Millennia raises Ultimate damage every 60s.
Vesh ranks last among Kallari jungle Eternals with enough games; Lotus leans ahead of Demiurge.
The Tenth Seal with Millennia is the field's best Vesh pair on Kallari jungle.
augment: Critical Override lets Kallari abilities critically strike, with critical damage cut by 35%.
Deadly Finesse is clearly the field's best Kallari jungle augment; Critical Override ranks last.
crest: Nex's Reap is an active dash damaging nearby heroes, boosted by Sow damage stored from hero hits.
Liberator and Witchstalker lead a toss-up in the Kallari jungle field; Nex, the most played, trails the pair.
improvement: Deadly Finesse over Critical Override is the field-backed swap: dagger cooldown cuts and mana on hero hits, giving up ability crits.
Witchstalker over Nex cleanses all debuffs on the same Assassin Crest path, giving up Reap's dash and slow.

matchup: Duo was Legion and Steel against Revenant and Murdock; Revenant scored four of ten Legion deaths.
Legion out-damaged Revenant 44957 hero damage to 23778.
Feng Mao added four Legion kills: on the duo lane, mid, the offlane and in the allied base.
build: Deathstalker is the lone winning-core item; Malady and Spear Of Desolation gave way to Terminus and Imperator.
Terminus turns overhealing from lifesteal into a shield.
Tainted Trident cuts healing 45% on physical damage, a fit into Feng Mao's 22917 healing, the game's most.
eternal: Demiurge raises item stats and item-effect damage by 10%; Tri-Core adds 5% on-hit damage of a random type.
Knell leans ahead in the Legion carry field; Demiurge ranks fourth behind Xyris and Lotus.
Construct with Memory Leak is Demiurge's best pair; Tri-Core with Memory Leak trails.
augment: Heavy Caliber stretches the attack timer to 0.75s for 310% damage and 100 more range, on a six-round magazine.
Heavy Caliber leans ahead of Scorched Earth in the Legion carry field. Sound keep.
crest: Ortus's Limit Breaker is an active: movement speed and physical power for 7s, with permanent power from takedowns.
Epoch leans ahead in the Legion carry field; Ortus, the most played, ranks third behind Nex.
Epoch starts from Wizard Crest, Ortus from Assassin Crest.
improvement: Epoch over Ortus is the field-backed crest test: a 2.5s Stasis in a ten-death game, giving up Limit Breaker.
Malady and Spear Of Desolation, the 55.6% winning core with Deathstalker, are the item test over Terminus and Imperator.

matchup: Crunch was the lane opponent: one Countess kill on Crunch, two Crunch kills on Countess, gold 22505 to 22375.
Feng Mao, not Crunch, was the offlane problem: five of eight Countess deaths.
Feng Mao's Hamstring slows on each hit and adds bonus damage when only a single target is hit.
build: Noxia and Lifebinder are two of three winning-core items; Orb Of Growth is missing, Tainted Scepter and Overseer off-meta.
Overseer enhances Feast: 15% more damage and healing for 25% of hero damage dealt.
No item carries physical armor against Feng Mao's 49298 hero damage in a four-physical enemy comp.
eternal: Lich adds magical lifesteal by level, and Mind Rot adds 2% current-health damage to the Vesh damage over time.
Lich with Mind Rot is the field's best Vesh pair on Countess offlane, so the minors stay.
Aion leans ahead of Vesh, the most played, in the Countess offlane field.
augment: Sanguine Slash adds 20% Blade Siphon damage and 50% more healing against isolated targets.
Sanguine Slash is the most played Countess offlane augment, but ranks third behind Shadow Echo and Blood Well, tied leads.
crest: Soulbearer's Anima active grants a shield for 8s plus 20% magical lifesteal and 10% movement speed.
Voidgazer is clearly the field's best Countess offlane crest, on the same Wizard Crest path; Soulbearer ranks third.
improvement: Golem's Gift brings 40 physical armor and 75 magical power; swap for Magnify when Feng Mao gets ahead, giving up omnivamp.
Voidgazer over Soulbearer is the field-backed crest change: a slowing projectile, then 15% more damage to targets hit, giving up the shield.

matchup: Gideon was the mid opponent: 46575 hero damage to 31416 from Argus, and 9001 objective damage to 951.
Argus killed Gideon twice and died to Gideon once; Feng Mao scored three of four Argus deaths.
Gideon's Spellbreaker blocks the next ability, and Feng Mao's Safeguard grants a Spellshield.
build: Azure Core, Entropy and Wraith Leggings are the exact winning core; Combustion and Caustica are off-meta.
Caustica ignores 35% of magical armor, a fit into the 40 magical armor on Gideon's Spellbreaker.
Wraith Leggings adds 12% bonus magical ability damage against heroes below 40% health.
eternal: Lich with Mind Rot, the pair run here, is the field's best Vesh pair on Argus mid.
Satariel leans ahead of Vesh, the most played, in the Argus mid field; Fearless stacks are lost on death.
augment: Infinite Obliteration gives Synaptic Obliterator infinite range, 50% faster projectiles and 50% longer slows.
Infinite Obliteration leans ahead of Arcane Engine in the Argus mid field. Sound keep.
crest: Soulbearer is clearly the field's best Argus mid crest. Sound keep.
improvement: No item change proven: the exact winning core was built.
Satariel over Vesh is the field lean, trading damage over time for takedown stacks lost on every death.

matchup: Duo was Steel and Legion against Murdock and Revenant; Legion died three times before minute ten, Steel zero.
Steel killed Murdock three times and Revenant once.
build: Xenia and Dynamo are two of three winning-core items; Gaia Greaves is missing, four items off-meta.
Warden's Faith cuts critical-strike damage taken by 20% and lowers nearby enemy heroes' physical power by 8%.
Dynamo makes immobilized enemies take 8% more damage for 2.5s, paired with Shield Bash and Bull Rush stuns.
eternal: The engine does not model support Eternals; Krix is the most played Steel support pick but trails Knell, Pilow and Idrisil.
Regenerative Tissue with Cannibalism is the best Krix pair in the field.
augment: Heavy Metal adds bonus magical damage on Heavy Punches and Shield Bash equal to 10% of total armors.
Colossal Crash and Heavy Metal lead a toss-up in the Steel support field. Sound keep.
crest: Sanctification's Safeguard active shields Steel and nearby heroes, with 50% tenacity while the shield holds.
Leafsong leans ahead of Sanctification, the most played, on the same Warden Crest path.
improvement: Leafsong over Sanctification is the field lean: 30% ally speed and slow immunity, giving up the tenacity shield.
Gaia Greaves, the missing winning-core item, adds 50 physical armor, the test in place of Oathkeeper's magical power.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~1.3s of lockdown): Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Murdock. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
Enemy is 4/5 physical — a single armor item blunts most of their damage; itemize armor on anyone diveable.
Dive threat on our backline: Crunch. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Countess Feast (suppress 0.75s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Steel) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Shadow Walk stealth → Crippling Dagger slow → Shadow Dance gap-close → Guillotine execute ult
ourKits.winCondition: stealth-pick an isolated squishy and execute with Guillotine
ourKits.passive: Death Mark detonates for bonus burst
ourKits.playWith: a team that follows her pick
ourKits.playAgainst: ward/reveal for the stealth; she's the squishiest hero — any CC kills her

ourKits.combo: Shadow Slip in → Eventide → Blade Siphon → Feast suppress ult, Haemorrhage true-damage
ourKits.winCondition: Feast-suppress a squishy and delete them with true-damage burst
ourKits.passive: two-ability hits apply a %max-HP true-damage bleed
ourKits.playWith: a team to clean up after her pick
ourKits.playAgainst: Feast is her whole engage — bait it / peel; she's fragile, punish the recast window

ourKits.combo: Dread Nova stun → Ether Crystal push/lift → Particle Shredder channel → Synaptic Obliterator beams
ourKits.winCondition: poke from max range and zone with the crystal
ourKits.playWith: a frontline to protect his stationary channel
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova; dive him during the immobile ult channel

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

enemyKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
enemyKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
enemyKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
enemyKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
enemyKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

enemyKits.combo: Reaping Dash → Hamstring slows → Safeguard spellshield → Earth Shatter execute
enemyKits.winCondition: trade with the spellshield up and execute low targets with Earth Shatter
enemyKits.passive: permanent power on unique hero takedowns
enemyKits.playWith: setup that holds a target for the execute
enemyKits.playAgainst: bait Safeguard's spellshield before committing the key CC

enemyKits.combo: Scar mark → Obliterate homing missiles → Reckoning 1v1 realm ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Reckoning a target into the Nether Realm and crit them down 1v1
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up if his 1v1 stalls
enemyKits.playAgainst: the ult is a 1v1 — peel the realmed ally can't help, so don't be caught alone; he's crit-reliant early-weak

enemyKits.combo: Forward Crunch gap-close stun → Right Crunch knockup → empowered Left Crunch, sustain via Re-Crunch
enemyKits.winCondition: all-in a squishy with the empowered combo and heal back through Re-Crunch
enemyKits.passive: post-ability empowered basic that refunds cooldowns
enemyKits.playWith: peel-stripping engage so he reaches the backline
enemyKits.playAgainst: peel/CC him off — without resets he's stranded; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch

enemyKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
enemyKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
enemyKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
enemyKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down
